rawResults.Title: SQL analytics endpoint performance considerations
rawResults.Snippet: May 21, 2026The Microsoft Fabric platform transparently manages the sync process. When a change is detected in a lakehouse, a background process updates metadata and the SQL analytics endpoint reflects the changes committed to lakehouse tables. Under normal operating conditions, the lag between a lakehouse and SQL analytics endpoint is less than one minute.
